summary: Iteration 118: Admin Payout Management Module Testing. All 21 tests passed. The payout management system is fully functional with single/bulk payout marking, double-payout prevention, partner order details, CSV export, and proper admin auth enforcement.

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. Frontend /admin/payouts page not tested.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Orders created with payoutStatus='pending' by default
✓ POST /api/referral/admin/mark-payout marks order as paid with payoutDate, payoutReference, payoutMethod, paidByAdmin
✓ POST /api/referral/admin/bulk-payout marks multiple orders as paid with batchId
✓ POST /api/referral/admin/bulk-payout skips already-paid orders and reports them with reason
✓ GET /api/referral/admin/partner-orders/{code} returns orders with all payout details
✓ GET /api/referral/admin/sales-overview partners have paidAmount and pendingAmount
✓ GET /api/referral/admin/export-payouts returns CSV with all payout fields (Payout Status, Payout Date, Payout Reference, Payout Method, Batch ID)

✓ Admin auth required for all payout endpoints (non-admin gets 422)
seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup test partner (TEST_payout_partner_*), test users (TEST_payout_user_*), and test orders automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 118 tested the Admin Payout Management module. Key findings: (1) Orders have payoutStatus='pending' by default. (2) Single payout via POST /api/referral/admin/mark-payout works - sets payoutStatus='paid', payoutDate, payoutReference, payoutMethod, paidByAdmin. (3) Double-payout prevention works - already-paid orders return 400. (4) Invalid orderId returns 400, non-existent orderId returns 404. (5) Bulk payout via POST /api/referral/admin/bulk-payout works - marks multiple orders with shared batchId, skips already-paid orders and reports them. (6) GET /api/referral/admin/partner-orders/{code} returns full order details with payout fields and correct paidAmount/pendingAmount/totalCommission. (7) GET /api/referral/admin/sales-overview includes pendingPayout and paidOutAmount at global level, and paidAmount/pendingAmount per partner. (8) GET /api/referral/admin/export-payouts returns CSV with all payout fields. (9) GET /api/referral/sales-stats uses payoutStatus for pendingEarnings and paidOutEarnings. (10) All admin payout endpoints require admin auth (422 without auth). (11) Existing referral endpoints unchanged.
